# Project Configuration

<!-- Auto-generated by /ccfold. Manual edits are preserved on re-fold. -->

## Platform
- **Host:** GitHub
- **CLI:** gh
- **Remote:** git@github.com:Wave-Engineering/mattermost-crew.git

## Branching
- **Merge strategy:** squash

## Status Mechanism
- **Type:** GitHub native (open/closed; no Status field)
- **Agent instruction:** When you cut the branch, assign the issue to yourself. When you open the PR, put `Closes #N` in its body; the linked PR is the in-review marker. Never close an issue by hand before the merge. After the merge, verify that the issue closed.

## Existing Labels
<!-- Labels in use on this repo — do not conflict -->
- **type::** plan, epic, feature, story, bug, chore, doc
- **priority::** critical, high, medium, low
- **urgency::** immediate, soon, normal, eventual
- **size::** S, M, L, XL
- **severity::** critical, major, minor, cosmetic
- **wave::** 1 to 9
- **epic::** 626
- **GitHub defaults:** bug, documentation, duplicate, enhancement, good first issue, help wanted, invalid, question, wontfix

## Toolchain
- **Validation:** `./scripts/ci/validate.sh` (`uv sync --frozen`, then `make lint`: ruff, mypy).
- **Tests:** `./scripts/ci/test.sh` (`make test`: pytest, reports under `reports/`). `make ci` runs both. Integration tests skip without `MM_URL`/`MM_ADMIN_TOKEN`; start a server with `scripts/ci/mattermost-up.sh`.
- **Build:** none yet. Releases will build sdists and wheels (Dev Spec §5.B).
- **Lint:** ruff and mypy through a uv workspace on Python 3.12.

## CI
- **System:** GitHub Actions.
- **Config:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, a matrix over three Mattermost legs, with each step one line calling `scripts/ci/*.sh`.
